subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: “You have cut off your hair ? ” asked Jim. “Cut it off and sold it, ” said Della. “Don’t you like me just as well anymore? I am me, without my hair, aren’t I?” Jim looked about the room curiously. “You say your hair is gone?” he said, with an air of almost of idiocy.
guide_solution: Mrs S. Ahmed told her student that she had heard the news of his illness the previous day. She also asked him how he was then. In reply the student told her respectfully that he felt a bit well that day. After that, Mrs. S. Ahmed forbade him to worry and consoled him that he would come round soon.
